author: Slidebean
description:
Sony just changed how TVs work

Sony didn’t launch a new TV.
They changed the backlight.

Instead of one light + filters,
they use RGB LEDs at the source.

Result?
High brightness + accurate color.

This could end the tradeoff
the TV industry has had for years.

title: The next evolution of TVs

author: Slidebean
description:
The internet lives underwater

Less than 1% of internet traffic uses satellites.

Everything else runs through
undersea cables.

Millions of kilometers of fiber
carrying your data as light.

When one breaks,
entire countries can go offline.

The cloud isn’t in the sky.
It’s at the bottom of the ocean.

title: Your internet runs underwater

author: Slidebean
description:
GPS only works because time is wrong

Every GPS satellite has a clock set to the wrong speed.

Because in space,
time runs differently.

Without correcting for relativity,
your location would be off by kilometers.

So engineers adjust the clocks before launch.

Every time you use GPS,
you’re relying on Einstein.

title: How GPS actually works
